title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Salesforce MuleSoft Lead Developer** with 6-10 years of IT experience, including strong expertise in **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Salesforce integration, API-led connectivity, and enterprise application integration**. The ideal candidate will lead the design, development, implementation, and support of integration solutions, ensuring scalable and secure APIs while collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.

The candidate should possess strong technical leadership capabilities, hands-on development expertise, and experience delivering integration solutions in Agile environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and implement integration solutions using **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform**.
* Lead end-to-end integration projects involving **Salesforce CRM** and other enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain APIs using MuleSoft's API-led connectivity approach.
* Design reusable integration frameworks, templates, and common services.
* Implement RESTful and SOAP web services, microservices, and event-driven integrations.
* Collaborate with architects, business analysts, and product owners to understand integration requirements.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
* Lead troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support activities.
* Mentor and guide junior developers and integration engineers.
* Manage deployments through CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Ensure API security, governance, monitoring, and compliance standards are met.
* Participate in solution design discussions and contribute to enterprise integration strategies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

### **Technical Skills**

* 6-10 years of overall IT experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform**.
* Strong experience in: Mule 4 Anypoint Studio API Manager Runtime Manager Exchange DataWeave 2.0 CloudHub / CloudHub 2.0
* Experience integrating Salesforce with: SAP Oracle Workday ServiceNow Banking/ERP applications Third-party systems
* Strong understanding of: REST APIs SOAP Web Services JSON XML RAML OpenAPI Specifications
* Experience with Salesforce technologies: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Salesforce APIs Platform Events Bulk API Streaming API
* Knowledge of messaging technologies: Kafka JMS MQ Event-driven architectures
* Experience with databases: SQL Server Oracle MySQL PostgreSQL
* Hands-on experience with: Git Jenkins Azure DevOps GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines

### **Leadership Skills**

* Experience leading and coordinating development teams.
* Ability to drive technical discussions and solution reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience estimating effort and planning project deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* MuleSoft Certified Developer (MCD - Level 1/2).
* MuleSoft Platform Architect Certification.
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Platform Developer Certification.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Knowledge of integration patterns, enterprise architecture, and security best practices.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* API Design & Development
* Enterprise Integration
* Salesforce Integration
* Technical Leadership
* Problem Solving
* Performance Optimization
* Stakeholder Management
* Agile Delivery
* Team Mentoring

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

title: Security Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

The Security Architect is a cross\-domain cybersecurity authority responsible for designing and positioning end\-to\-end security architectures spanning Network Security, End User Computing (EUC) Security, and Data Centre Security. The role serves both ISP clients (managing telco\-grade security infrastructure) and MSI customers (enterprise security transformation). A strong commercial mindset and pre\-sales ability are essential to position security as a value driver rather than a cost centre.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect holistic security solutions covering perimeter, internal segmentation, endpoint, cloud, and identity layers
* Design network security solutions: NGFW, IPS/IDS, SD\-WAN security overlays, DDoS protection, and carrier\-grade NAT/CGN security
* Architect End User Computing security — endpoint protection platforms (EPP), EDR/XDR, VDI security, email security, and web proxy/filtering
* Design Data Centre security: micro\-segmentation, East\-West firewall controls, WAF, privileged access management (PAM), and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA)
* Position and architect SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and SSE solutions — Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cato Networks
* Develop SOC design frameworks, SIEM architecture (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar), and SOAR playbooks
* Lead security assessments, gap analyses, and compliance mapping (ISO 27001, NIST, PCI\-DSS, GDPR, NCA ECC in KSA/UAE)
* Respond to security\-focused RFPs, build BoMs, and lead technical presentations to CISO\-level stakeholders
* Maintain strong OEM relationships with Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Zscaler, and Milestone PSIM/VMS
* Provide guidance on ICCC (Integrated Command \& Control Centre) security integration — PSIM, video surveillance, access control

**◆ Technical Expertise — Hands\-On Requirements**

* Palo Alto Networks: PAN\-OS, Panorama, Prisma Access, Prisma Cloud — hands\-on deployment and policy management
* Fortinet: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS — advanced routing security and SD\-WAN integration
* Check Point: Smart Console, CPUSE, CloudGuard — policy administration and HA deployment
* Microsoft 365 Defender stack: Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, and Sentinel SIEM
* Network segmentation: VLANs, ACLs, micro\-segmentation with VMware NSX\-T or Illumio
* Identity and access management: Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, CyberArk PAM
* Vulnerability management tools: Tenable Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 — enterprise scanning and reporting
* ICCC / Physical Security integration: Milestone XProtect, Genetec, Lenel, Honeywell Pro\-Watch — understanding of video analytics and access control
* Cloud security posture management (CSPM) on AWS, Azure, and GCP

title: Network Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The Network Architect is the most versatile technical authority in the Solution Engineering team, covering the full spectrum of IP networking from ISP backbone design to enterprise SD\-WAN, NFV, SASE, and GPON/FTTH access deployments. This role is critical to the MSI business where integrated network solutions are central to large deal pursuits. The architect must combine CCIE\-level depth with the commercial acumen to shape multi\-vendor network proposals for carrier, enterprise, and government customers.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect carrier\-grade IP/MPLS backbone, metro Ethernet, and Service Provider edge networks
* Design enterprise campus and branch networks: Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS), Switching (RSTP, EVPN\-VXLAN), and network automation
* Architect SD\-WAN solutions — Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN (Viptela), VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet SD\-WAN, and Nokia Nuage for large enterprise and ISP overlay deployment
* Design NFV/SDN architectures using OpenStack, ONAP, Kubernetes CNFs, and virtual CPE (vCPE) platforms
* Architect SASE frameworks — positioning Secure SD\-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, and FWaaS as integrated cloud\-delivered services (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Fortinet SASE)
* Design GPON / XGS\-PON / FTTH networks — OLT, ONT/ONU sizing, OSP design, splitter ratios, and integration with BSS/OSS provisioning
* Support ISP metro and access network designs including DWDM, OTN, Carrier Ethernet, and L2/L3 VPN services
* Develop network HLD/LLD documentation, IP addressing plans, QoS frameworks, and migration strategies
* Represent network solutions in pre\-sales: demos, PoCs, network simulation labs, and executive briefings
* Maintain OEM partnerships: Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Ericsson, ZTE, Ciena, Ribbon, and Fortinet

**◆ Technical Expertise — Hands\-On Requirements**

* IP/MPLS core: RSVP\-TE, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS, SRv6\), Traffic Engineering, and Fast Reroute (FRR)
* BGP — iBGP, eBGP, BGP\-LU, BGP\-EVPN for DC and WAN, route policies and filtering
* Data Centre fabrics: Spine\-Leaf, BGP EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, Juniper Apstra
* SD\-WAN hands\-on: Zero\-touch provisioning, policy\-based routing, SLA\-driven path selection, and orchestrator management
* NFV: OpenStack Heat templates, VIM/NFVO, VNF onboarding, Kubernetes Helm charts for CNFs
* GPON: OLT configuration (Nokia 7360, ZTE C320\), OMCI provisioning, TR\-069, and IPTV multicast
* SASE: Hands\-on with at least one platform (Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Palo Alto Prisma Access, or Fortinet FortiSASE)
* Network automation: Ansible, Python/Netmiko, NAPALM, Terraform, and Cisco NSO/YANG model awareness

title: IoT Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist who can design end\-to\-end IoT solutions from the device/sensor layer through connectivity, edge processing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As the ISP transitions to an MSI model, IoT is a key growth vertical — spanning smart cities, industrial automation, smart metering, fleet management, healthcare IoT, and building management systems. The ideal candidate has a wide aperture across networking, cloud, data, and security, and can position IoT solutions confidently in commercial discussions.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures: device layer, connectivity (LPWAN / NB\-IoT / LTE\-M / 5G / Wi\-Fi 6 / LoRaWAN / Zigbee), edge, and cloud platform
* Architect IoT platforms: AWS IoT Core / Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub / IoT Central, Google Cloud IoT Core, ThingsBoard, or Bosch IoT Suite
* Design edge computing architectures: AWS Outposts / Local Zones, Azure IoT Edge, NVIDIA Jetson platforms for real\-time inference
* Develop smart city solution architectures: smart metering, smart lighting, traffic management, waste management, and environmental monitoring
* Architect industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for manufacturing, oil \& gas, utilities, and smart buildings — integrating OT/IT convergence via ISA\-95/IEC 62443
* Design IoT security frameworks: device identity management (PKI/X.509\), TLS/DTLS transport security, OTA update management, and network segmentation
* Position IoT connectivity services leveraging ISP assets (NB\-IoT, LTE\-M network, eSIM, APN management)
* Support MSI bids: technical solution writing, BoQ for gateways, sensors, platform licences, and integration services
* Maintain broad OEM awareness: Cisco IoT, Sierra Wireless, Telit, Advantech, Cradlepoint, and platform vendors
* Conduct market sensing — staying current on emerging IoT standards (Matter, Thread, Wi\-Fi HaLow, 5G URLLC for IIoT)

**◆ Technical Expertise — Broad Knowledge Requirements**

**The IoT Architect role requires broad technology coverage rather than a single deep\-stack specialism:**

* Connectivity layer: NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, LoRaWAN, Sigfox, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, Thread, Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Bluetooth LE — protocol trade\-offs and application mapping
* Edge platforms: AWS IoT Greengrass, Azure IoT Edge, Balena.io, or equivalent — deployment, container orchestration at edge
* Cloud IoT platforms: device registry, message brokering (MQTT/AMQP/HTTP), time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, Azure ADX)
* Data analytics: stream processing (Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs), batch analytics, and BI dashboarding (Grafana, Power BI, Tableau)
* AI/ML at edge: TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, or NVIDIA Triton inference — awareness of on\-device ML for anomaly detection
* Security: PKI for device identity, FIPS 140\-2, CVE awareness for embedded systems, IEC 62443 for ICS/SCADA environments
* Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, AMQP, LwM2M, OPC\-UA — strengths and appropriate use cases

title: BIM Engineer (Arch)
description:
Experience \- 3\+ Years  

  

Key Responsibilities* Develop and maintain accurate **3D BIM models** using Autodesk Revit in accordance with project requirements and BIM standards.
* Create and modify **Revit families, parametric components, and BIM content** as required.
* Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to ensure accurate model development.
* Perform **clash detection and coordination** with relevant disciplines to resolve model conflicts.
* Conduct self\-QC checks to ensure model accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project standards.
* Prepare **2D drawings, shop drawings, sections, elevations, and schedules** from BIM models.
* Update BIM models based on design revisions, client comments, and coordination feedback.
* Manage model files, work sets, and project deliverables using **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM 360**, and other CDE platforms.
* Complete assigned tasks within project timelines while maintaining required productivity and quality standards.
* Coordinate with **BIM Coordinators, BIM Managers, Architects, and project teams** to ensure smooth project execution and timely deliverables.

### **Requirements**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Autodesk Revit – Architecture**.
* Good understanding of **BIM workflows, architectural modeling, documentation, and coordination**.
* Experience creating and editing **Revit families and parametric content**.
* Knowledge of **clash detection and multidisciplinary BIM coordination**.
* Familiarity with **ACC/BIM 360 and Common Data Environment (CDE)** workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to perform independent quality checks.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work effectively within project deadlines.
